name: Regulations 23, 29, 25(5) and 25(6) in force after 150 days (r. 1(2)(e) as substituted)

attrs.quote: regulations 23, 29 and sub-regulations (5) and (6) of regulation 25 of these regulations shall come into force after 150 days
attrs.note: window is computed: 150 days after publication in the Official Gazette, dated 19 July 2018. Clause (e) was substituted on 21 December 2018, after that date.
